ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $BO$ bisects $\angle ABC$, $CO$ bisects $\angle ACB$, $MN$ passes through point $O$ and is parallel to $BC$, intersecting $AB$ and $AC$ at $M$ and $N$, respectively. Given $AB=12$, $AC=18$, and $MN=BM+CN$, what is the perimeter of $\triangle AMN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From (1) we know that $MN = BM + CN$,\\
$\therefore$ the perimeter of $\triangle AMN = AM + AN + MN = AM + AN + BM + CN = AB + AC$,\\
$\because$ $AB = 12$, $AC = 18$,\\
$\therefore$ the perimeter of $\triangle AMN = AB + AC = \boxed{30}$.
